name: Macy's Union Square - Geary Street (Union Square) building
address: 235-281 Geary St (store address 170 O'Farrell St), San Francisco, CA 94102
corner: mid-block, south side of Geary between Stockton and Powell, facing the plaza; abuts I. Magnin building (E) and 285-295 Geary corner building (W)
yearBuilt: 1998 (replaced the 1967 Dohrmann's-site front and the 1976 Bally/Werner building at 255 Geary); complex origin 1929
architect: Patri Burlage Merker Architects (1998); overall complex Lewis P. Hobart (1929, 1948-49)
style: Late-modern glass curtain wall - a 'contemporary interpretation' of the 1917 Hallidie Building; grey stone end piers
floors: 6 visible on the façade (ground + 5 window rows) plus set-back roof levels (Macy's 7th/8th floors, Cheesecake Factory terrace); complex 8 floors + lower level
heightNote: ≈34 m parapet of the glass façade (est. from photos); set-back roof levels bring the mass to ≈45 m (OSM height=45 for the whole complex)
roofType: flat; planted roof terrace behind the parapet with 3 flagpoles (US, California, Macy's) above the bow; roof restaurant (Cheesecake Factory, 'Macy's 8th floor') set back
facadeMaterial: clear + translucent glass panels in silver-grey aluminium mullions with grey stone spandrel bands; polished grey granite/limestone end piers and ground-floor frame
bays: 5 horizontal segments (W→E): stone pier 6 m | glazed wing 5 bays 19 m | bowed glass atrium 13 m | glazed wing 3 bays 13 m | stone pier 8 m
bayWidthNote: west wing bays ≈3.8 m (5), east wing bays ≈4.4 m (3); rows are 5 m tall floor bands separated by 1 m spandrels
windowType: floor-to-ceiling curtain-wall glazing in each bay (display floors visible from the street); bow is continuous curved glazing with horizontal mullion bands per floor
base: ground floor: stone-framed display windows and carved-out retail bays; central entrance recess with flat metal canopy ≈12 m wide at ≈4.5 m
cornice: none - flat parapet with planters; curved parapet panel over the bow carries the main sign
notableFeatures: Bowed (convex) 5-storey glass atrium ≈13 m wide centred ≈31 m from the west end / ≈28 m from the I. Magnin party wall; contains the escalator well and seasonal displays (giant tree Nov-Jan)
SIGN 1: 'macy's' logotype, white/silver channel letters ≈12 m wide × 2.5 m, on the curved parapet above the bow at ≈33 m; star apostrophe lit RED at night (photo 02, Dec 2024)

SIGN 2: small 'macy's' ≈3 m on the entrance canopy fascia (star red); SIGN 3: 'The Cheesecake Factory' + 'Burger Bar' grey plaques ≈2.5 m square on BOTH stone end piers at 3rd/4th-floor height (photos 2010-2020; Burger Bar status 2026 UNRESOLVED)
Seasonal: window wreaths on every bay and red star cut-outs in the bow (Nov-Jan); rooftop billboard on the neighbouring 285 Geary building often carries Macy's ads
Structure buttresses the two adjacent buildings (former I. Magnin and the 1929 main store)
Lower level food court (Boudin, Subway, Jamba, Wetzel's) per OSM 2024-25
STATUS 2026: OPEN. Feb-2024 closure plan (exit 2027) abandoned 4 Nov 2025 - Macy's + TMG Partners partnership to redevelop the ≈600,000 sq ft property; no closure date; OSM check 2026-04-09

name: 233 Geary - former I. Magnin & Co. 'White Marble Palace' (Louis Vuitton / Loro Piana)

style: Streamline/Moderne stripped-classical marble box with a regular grid of punched windows

facadeMaterial: white Vermont (Danby) marble panels; bronze/black storefront frames
frontageNote: Geary width from OSM Macy's footprint minus the 1998 building; Stockton depth estimated (the 1929 Macy's building continues south to O'Farrell)
bays: 7 window columns on Geary (7 rows above ground); Stockton face similar grid (≈7 columns)
windowType: punched near-square windows ≈2.2 × 2.4 m, dark frames, deep marble reveals; 2-storey storefront vitrines at grade
base: 2-storey retail base: Louis Vuitton at the corner (Geary + Stockton faces), Loro Piana west of it on Geary; black fascia, brass letters
notableFeatures: 'macy's' logotype in grey letters on the upper marble wall of the Geary face (2008 photo) - removed after the 2019 sale; current upper-wall signage UNRESOLVED (likely none)

Renovation programme (2020 application): retail floors 1-2 (LV + Loro Piana share the plates), 3rd floor multi-tenant retail, floors 4-8 offices (93,190 sq ft), 4 residential storeys incl. two penthouses (1,760 & 1,900 sq ft)
